content:
sara: pinging eng-releases — seeing a spike of 503s from kv-cache misses in eu-west1 since 02:10 UTC. Reproducer points to eviction window miscalculation. I built a hotfix (sha: c3f9b2a). Need expedited approve+deploy. Details: https://artifacts.redwood/builds/12345 :rotating_light:

mike: can you share a quick rollout plan? can we do a small canary first?

sara: plan: canary 10% in eu-west1, monitor latency+5xx on the Datadog dashboard for 10m, then progress to 50% then 100% if stable. If errors spike -> rollback immediate. Request: region-pin to eu-west1 only (skip global canary). need ops signoff.

alex: @ops-oncall you good with 10m watch? also what's the rollback criteria?

ops-oncall: we can do a 10m watch. Rollback if 5xx rate > 0.5% OR p95 latency increases by >50ms. I’ll stay on this thread and monitor. :white_check_mark:

sara: deploy artifact sha c3f9b2a, image: gcr.io/redwood/runtime:hotfix-c3f9b2a

nina: QA checked smoke and repro locally, looks good. Release note draft: "kv-cache eviction window bugfix — reduces transient 503s for short-lived keys."

mike: approving. :thumbsup: @releasebot please attach release note and tag hotfix/eviction-2026-03-23

releasebot: Added tag hotfix/eviction-2026-03-23 and attached release notes: https://release.redwood/hotfixes/eviction-2026-03-23

deploybot: Request received: start canary -> eu-west1 -> 10% -> image=gcr.io/redwood/runtime:hotfix-c3f9b2a sha=c3f9b2a
deploybot: /deploy canary eu-west1 10% image=gcr.io/redwood/runtime:hotfix-c3f9b2a sha=c3f9b2a
deploybot: Canary started (id: cb-6135792468). Monitoring hooks: datadog + traces. ETA 5m for first metrics.

sara: pasted quick tail for context:
```
[02:11:05] WARN eviction miss key=usr:cache:xyz
[02:11:07] ERR kvclient rpc timeout
```

ops-oncall: seeing canary metrics now — 0.04% 5xx, p95 +10ms. green so far.

mike: proceed to 50% in eu-west1. i'm holding ring approval.

sara: rolling to 50% now.

deploybot: Rolling canary to 50% (id cb-6135792468) -> progress 50% in eu-west1. ETA ~3m.

ops-oncall: 0.06% 5xx, p95 +12ms. traces show fewer eviction hits. still good.

nina: QA will validate post-50% smoke, +1 from docs to publish release note.

mike: final approve for 100% in eu-west1. no global rollout yet.

sara: applying 100% -> deploybot please.

deploybot: Rolling to 100% in eu-west1...
deploybot: Deploy successful in eu-west1 (cb-6135792468). Post-deploy checks passing.

ops-oncall: monitoring for 30m. If no regressions we'll close and cherry-pick fix to main and schedule wider rollouts. :eyes:

sara: thanks all — filing postmortem notes and pushing fix to master. Notifying product that incident is mitigated.

mike: add release note link to incident ticket INC-7890 and mark incident as resolved pending 30m watch.

ops-oncall: will close on our side in 30m if metrics stay stable.
